### SSH Access

```bash
# SSH into running instance
clever ssh

# Run a command
clever ssh --command "ls -la"
```

### Applications Management

```bash
# List all applications in organization
clever applications list

clever cancel-deploy
```

## ssh

A Clever Cloud application is a running virtual machine you can ssh to, as a user (`bas`). By default, it will use `OpenSSH` configuration, but you can target a specific identity file:

```
clever ssh [--identity-file, -i] IDENTITY-FILE
```

To ssh a specific application, use:

```
clever ssh --app APP_ID_OR_NAME
```

## logs

When you deploy an application on Clever Cloud, we collect its logs, hosted in our internal Pulsar stack, all included. To listen to the stream, use:

```
clever logs
```

You can also get logs from a specific timeline, deployment or add-on through options:

I added `--command` to `clever ssh`, but nothing is verified yet: validation couldn't run, and I didn't run the new option against a real instance. The guide update and the docs regeneration aren't done either.

**What changed** (`src/commands/ssh/ssh.command.js`):
- **New option:** `--command <command>` takes a string. When it's set, the command is added as the last argument to `ssh`, after the instance ID: `ssh <gateway> <instanceId> "<command>"`. The skill file `skills/clever-tools/SKILL.md` already showed `clever ssh --command "ls -la"`, so it now matches.
- **No terminal for remote commands:** the interactive shell still forces a terminal session with `-t`. With `--command` it doesn't, so the command's output can be piped cleanly.
- **Exit code:** `clever ssh` now exits with the same code as `ssh`, so with `--command` it returns the remote command's exit code. If `ssh` is killed by a signal, the code is 1. This also applies to the interactive shell. Before, the code was always dropped, even though `AGENTS.md` says this file sets it.

**Still unverified:**
- **Gateway behaviour:** I'm assuming the Clever Cloud SSH gateway runs whatever follows the instance ID as the remote command. I couldn't confirm that from the repo. It needs one manual run on an app you choose, e.g. `node bin/clever.js ssh --app <app> --command "ls -la"`.
- **Dependencies aren't installed:** `npm run docs` stopped with a missing-module error and `npm run validate` with `eslint: command not found`. Lint, format, types and the generated `ssh.docs.md` are therefore unchecked. After an `npm ci`, run `npm run docs` then `npm run validate`, or tell me to and I'll do it.
- **User guide not updated:** permission to edit `docs/applications-deployment-lifecycle.md` was denied. I wanted to add this under the `ssh` section:
  > To run a command on the instance instead of opening an interactive shell, use `--command`. The CLI exits with the exit code of the remote command:
  > `clever ssh --command "ls -la"`

Nothing is committed. Per the repo rules, the PR needs an issue to close; if you want one, the commit would be `feat(ssh): add --command option to run a remote command`.
